messages:
Maria: FYI — bringup of reranker-xsmall-v2 (int4 quant) shows weird metrics on the prod_holdout slice.
Maria: Offline numbers vs prod: NDCG@10 +0.6% (95% CI +0.2, +1.0), MRR@1 -1.9% (95% CI -3.2, -0.6).
Alex: which holdout exactly? size and query-length distrib?
Maria: holdout = prod_holdout_2025_03, n=2,140 queries. median tokens=4, 55% labelled as nav-type.
Jia: note: we updated the labeler guide in March to "prefer broader matches" — could bias NDCG vs MRR.
Sam: we also rolled dense-recall v2 last week; candidate pool changed which affects top1.
Alex: can you compute candidate-top1 overlap between prod_recall and new_recall for the holdout?
Maria: quick overlap stat: top1 overlap = 72%, 28% of queries have a different top candidate.
Eval Bot: quick bootstrap summary: NDCG@10 delta p=0.003 (sig), MRR@1 delta p=0.08 (not quite). Per-slice: MRR drop concentrated in qlen <= 5.
Maria: snippet I used to reproduce locally: 
```
python eval/compute_metrics.py --pred preds.json --gold gold.json --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --bootstrap 1000
```
Alex: good. please attach preds and gold for the holdout so we can re-run with identical seeds.
Jia: I'm worried about labeler drift making MRR seem worse even if user-facing recall improved. We should run a relabel A/B on the affected queries.
Sam: also check per-candidate score shifts: if reranker now upweights broader matches, top1 relevance (MRR) could drop while ranked list quality (NDCG) improves.
Alex: propose stratified analysis: bootstrap by qlen bins (<=3, 4-7, >=8) and by query_type (nav/info). Also compute per-query delta and bucket by magnitude.
Maria: agreed. I'll run stratified bootstrap + per-query delta histograms and post results.
Jia: I'll prepare a 200-query sample from the qlen<=5 bucket for relabel with old vs new instructions.
Sam: add checks: candidate_source distribution (dense v sparse), top1 scorer identity, and score KDEs for top1.
Eval Bot: created task EVAL-482: "reranker-xsmall-v2 holdout relabel + stratified bootstrap" and attached current bootstrap artifact.
Maria: timeline: per-slice stats by EOW, relabel batch queued for next Tue. @Alex @Jia @Sam please confirm availability.
Alex: I can help tonight with overlap and score histograms.
Jia: available to coordinate relabel next Mon/Tue.
Sam: I'll run score KDEs and per-candidate breakdown tomorrow morning.
Maria: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll post the notebook link when ready.
